review_basis: Reviewer read the complete frozen source and compared original CRUD11 owned/act/click and the unchanged Continuation boundary. This records the review message; it is not device evidence.
observations: First exact database claim persists ownership before any further UI lookup
Save, Delete and one exact provider fallback have a separate pre-dispatch database-effect fence and exact readback
Unknown native input, close and database effects prohibit subsequent mutations or task removal
Uncertain close preserves its task identity and unresolved fence even if the original adapter cleared its reference
The old CRUD failure cleanup is not reused
Success requires two newly owned tasks, two verified normal closes, edited-name search and same-record detail, UI Delete, account topology, database, task and Main readbacks
Provider fallback is limited to persisted owned null-account raw/contact IDs and provides no UI-delete credit
